📯 MUSTER — scouts report The Audit hunting near Haven, and it is beyond us. Everyone inside. No one walks the treeline alone — the garden crews double up, the hunters stand down. We outlast it.

🔥 The fire settles. Caleb has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Angela says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🔭 Scouts come back pale. The System's ratings spike at odd hours. Something is performing out there and the numbers are INSANE.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🗺️ Scouts found its lair — tile 7,4. THE NIELSEN — ratings embodied. It is WAITING. You cannot face it alone. Sound the call.

You turn to leave — behind you, The Nielsen stirs.
